newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Trans-Lux Corp Q2 net net increases.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Trans-Lux Corp Q2 net net increases.

text.p: THREE MONTHS ENDED SIX MONTHS ENDED

NOTE: The fully diluted average shares outstanding assumes 2,257,000 and 2,236,000 shares upon conversion of the company's 7-1/2 percent convertible subordinated notes due 2006 for the second quarter and the first six months of 1997, respectively.
Net income for the first six months of 1997 included a special one-time charge of approximately $113,000, or $0.05 per primary share, for the unamortized portion of its financing costs in 1997.
Net income for the second quarter of 1997 included a charge of $74,000, or $0.05 per primary share, for a revaluation of rental equipment and the issuance of convertible subordinated notes.
Net income for the first six months of 1997 included a charge of $108,000, or $0.08 per primary share, for a revaluation of rental equipment and the issuance of convertible subordinated notes.
